source--target-audit-etda-threat-group-c.title: ETDA Threat Group Cards observed-country fields
source--target-audit-etda-threat-group-c.analyst_notes: High-confidence actor-name matches only. ETDA aggregates vendor reporting; observed-country entries are retained as medium-confidence targeting evidence with scope caveats.

source--target-audit-misp-threat-actor.title: MISP Galaxy Threat Actor victim geography fields
source--target-audit-misp-threat-actor.publisher: MISP Project / Council on Foreign Relations
source--target-audit-misp-threat-actor.analyst_notes: High-confidence actor-name matches only. Victim fields are aggregation leads and may inherit vendor collection-boundary differences; profile entries therefore use medium confidence.

source--mitre-attack-19-1.title: MITRE Enterprise ATT&CK 19.1 compact local index
source--mitre-attack-19-1.analyst_notes: Frozen historical ATT&CK release retained for Groups that are no longer current. Deprecated status is not interpreted as proof that the real-world actor ceased to exist.

source--mitre-attack-19-2.title: MITRE Enterprise ATT&CK 19.2 compact local index
source--mitre-attack-19-2.analyst_notes: Derived from the official MITRE attack-stix-data release. ATT&CK modification dates are not activity observation dates.

source--osint-misp-tidal-groups.title: MISP Galaxy TIDAL Groups
source--osint-misp-tidal-groups.analyst_notes: Dataset version=1. Aggregation match is a cross-check lead; vendor collection boundaries and original references must be reviewed before asserting exact identity.

research_gaps: Canonical activities exist, but their observation periods are unknown.
Malware is actor-linked only; campaign-specific use periods are unknown.
No canonical cross-actor relationship is structured.
